label: Bible Study
prompt: The LORD is _____, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
verse: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
note: Moses quotes God's own self-description from Sinai back to him while pleading for Israel's pardon.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise _____ out.
verse: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
note: No one who comes to Jesus gets turned away at the door — 'in no wise' means not in any way at all.

label: Sunday School
prompt: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white _____ on my head:
verse: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:
note: The chief baker's dream had three white baskets on his head — and Joseph's reading of it was not the good news he hoped for.

label: Deep Water
prompt: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early _____ it goeth away.
verse: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
note: Israel's devotion vanished like morning mist — gone before the day really started.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is _____.
verse: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
note: Proverbs doesn't soften it: love instruction and you love knowledge; hate reproof and you're 'brutish.'
